recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-33979 unless the work group later revisits the broader resource identity wording.
issue_request: FHIR-33979 was a Published FHIR-core change request with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked that the Developer Introduction Framework bullet stop implying that every resource intrinsically has a URL identifier and instead say that resources have an identifier, typically a URL.
initial_application: Commit 4a1befe248ccd6504c35025fb1f4fd4779ad1801 applied the issue by changing source/overview-dev.html from "A URL that identifies the resource" to "An identifier for the resource - typically a URL that defines where the resource is found".
additional_context: The related FHIR-33978 Resource-page issue made the same clarification in a neighboring artifact, supporting the identity-versus-URL interpretation. source/overview-dev.html is active build content through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini. Confluence and Zulip searches found no directly relevant or conflicting community evidence for FHIR-33979.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Framework bullet already preserves the approved wording's meaning by leading with an identifier for the resource and qualifying the URL as typical, while the later URLs and Identities section separately explains contextual RESTful resource URLs.
